_comment: The four pillars of Walrus knowledge, and which skill belongs to each.
A skill with evals but no entry here is reported as unmapped by walrusevals/list.js rather than
silently dropped, so adding a skill cannot quietly shrink the suite. `template` is the scaffold a
new skill is copied from and is left out of the suite by walrusevals/lib/suite.js, as the eval
pipeline leaves it out of every run.
The evals were written per skill and the pillars mapped onto them afterwards, so the pillars are
uneven. Scoring averages the four rather than pooling them, so an uneven count does not let the

pillars.name: Fundamentals
pillars.desc: What Walrus is and what it costs. Blobs, epochs, encoding, the WAL token, and the pricing a design decision rests on.

pillars.name: Storing
pillars.desc: Getting data in and keeping it there. The CLI, blob lifetimes and extension, deletable versus permanent blobs, and quilts for small files.

pillars.name: Building
pillars.desc: Shipping something on it. The TypeScript SDK, the HTTP API, Walrus blobs from Move, Walrus Sites, and agent memory.

pillars.name: Operating
pillars.desc: What goes wrong and what stays private. Encrypting before storage, and the errors a developer meets and how to read them.
